notes: Library: bigger recipe cards you can tap anywhere, and an Add recipe button near your thumb that opens every way to add one
Add a recipe: choosing a screenshot, photo, or PDF reads it right away, and pasting a link does too. Typing a recipe in has its own button
Stats: headline numbers, badges for milestones, and a chart of meals by week
Settings: your kitchen shows instantly, Recently Deleted can delete a recipe forever, and Sign out is at the bottom
Photos of finished dishes: add one to any day in the cook log, or right after cooking. You each get one photo per meal, and both phones see them
The newest photo shows at the top of the recipe and in the library
Photos are shrunk to about 300 KB on your phone and saved there, so they show offline. A kitchen keeps up to 500
Two-chef mode: checking off a step also checks your earlier steps, and checking a shared step checks both parts before it, so you can catch up with one tap. Undo is next to the message
Shared steps no longer wait for the other cook's check-offs. If their part isn't checked off, the step says so and you start when you're both ready
Recipes have prep and cook times, shown on the recipe and at the top of both cooking modes, so you can plan when to start things like the oven
Two-chef mode no longer tells you to "start now"; preheating is a regular step and the timing is your call
Amounts in the steps now match the servings you picked, in bold, so they never disagree with the ingredient list
Cooking modes show servings with a stepper, and in two-chef mode both phones share the same servings
Two-chef mode: time left, "start now" for steps like preheating, your next step marked in the list, give a step away right under Done, and what to tidy while you wait
Ask about a step and add a note for next time from either cooking mode, and leave with the X at the top
Half-star ratings: tap or drag across the stars
PDFs of any size import: a large PDF is read on the phone first and only the recipe text is sent
Links from sites that turn away apps get a second try, and errors say what happened and what to try instead
Two-chef mode: split a recipe between two cooks and cook at the same time, each on your own phone
Pick who makes what, and the other phone gets the other part; check-offs show on both phones
Shared steps wait until both parts are ready, and you can hand a step to the other cook or swap parts
Works on one phone too, and keeps going offline
Cooking mode lists the steps coming up under the current one, so you can read ahead without tapping
Finished steps are tucked under Done
Recipes have a total time, and each logged meal adds it to your time cooking together
Finishing in cooking mode logs that you made it; remove it from the cook log if it was a mistake
No more typing minutes by hand, and changing only the time or cuisine no longer asks you to re-rate
Add cooking time from a recipe's cook log, for when you didn't use cooking mode
The cook log shows each day's cooking time, and you can remove it
Time from cooking mode on a day that wasn't logged now shows in the cook log too
After a recipe changes, you can keep your rating instead of rating again
Ratings and the cook log take less space, and the ratings breakdown shows once, at the top
Servings: "Show original" is gone; when you change servings, a link sets it back to what the recipe makes
Plain black-and-white look, in light and dark mode, so testing is about how the app works
More even spacing between sections, and hover states on buttons and links
Accessibility fixes: fields you tab to stay clear of the bottom menu, every field shows a focus ring, and sync errors are in plain words
Earlier versions of recipes are no longer kept, and the Earlier versions section is gone
Notes still show what they changed, and "rate it again" still appears after the recipe is edited
Settings shows a version number and what's new in it, with earlier versions underneath
The update banner says which version is ready and what it changes
After an update, the app shows what's new once
Imported screenshots and PDFs aren't kept after you save; they show only while you check the recipe
Import picks up who a recipe is credited to, and the recipe shows "From ..."
New Credit field when adding or editing a recipe
Recipe cards in the Library show the average rating and how often you've made it
The update banner stays pinned to the top of the screen, and the app checks for updates more often
Notes look like a comments thread
A note can be turned into a recipe change only once, and then shows that it was used
A loading indicator with a seconds counter while Gemini works
Faster Gemini answers for imports, nutrition, and step questions
The app offers updates with a banner instead of quietly keeping an old copy
Changes from a note cover every part of the note, and anything Gemini couldn't apply is flagged
Saving a change from a note no longer posts a duplicate note
You can delete notes you wrote
Nutrition estimates: calories, protein, carbs, and fat per serving and for how much you ate
Ratings belong to the recipe and carry over each time you make it
The cook log is a diary of the dates you made a recipe
When you both log the same dinner, it counts as one meal
Turn a note into a recipe change: Gemini drafts it, you approve it
Earlier versions of a recipe can be viewed and restored
Cooking mode: one step at a time, large text, screen kept on
Ask Gemini about a step while cooking
Cook log with a rating from each of you, and a Stats page
Import recipes from screenshots, PDFs, links, and pasted text
Add and edit recipes, scale servings, switch units, leave notes, and use it offline
Remove a cook or leave a kitchen
Sign in, create a shared kitchen, and invite each other
